meta.description: Conduct comprehensive, systematic literature reviews using multiple academic databases (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar, etc.). This skill should be used when conducting systematic literature reviews, meta-analyses, research synthesis, or comprehensive literature searches across biomedical, scientific, and technical domains. Creates professionally formatted markdown documents and PDFs with verified citations in multiple citation styles (APA, Nature, Vancouver, etc.).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; systematic methodology with documented searches, citation verification, and reproducible search strategies

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for systematic literature reviews with PRISMA guidance; clear integration boundaries with database skills (gget, bioservices)

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established systematic review methodology (PRISMA, Cochrane), multi-database search strategies, and citation verification

code_usability.detail: Complete working examples for all workflow phases with bundled scripts for citation verification and document generation

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive 7-phase workflow (planning, search, screening, extraction, synthesis, verification, document generation) with 3 bundled scripts and integration with parallel-web, gget, bioservices

reliability.note: Good documentation of search reproducibility with date/query recording; version 1.7; dependency checks available; minor: no explicit guidance on handling API failures across multiple databases

performance_context.note: Well-organized 264-line SKILL.md with progressive disclosure through 2 reference files plus templates; clear 7-phase structure with integration points

agent_usability.note: Perfect trigger description with specific literature review patterns; comprehensive 'When to Use' section with 7 use cases; clear integration with parallel-web as primary search tool

human_usability.note: Excellent setup instructions with parallel-cli, Python packages (requests), system tools (pandoc, LaTeX), dependency check script, and complete workflow guidance

security.note: Good credential handling for parallel-cli authentication and OpenRouter API; citation verification prevents fabrication; minor: no explicit guidance on handling potentially malicious PDFs during full-text screening

maintainability.note: Good structure with version 1.7, license, openclaw API key declaration, 3 bundled scripts, reference files; minor: no explicit changelog reference

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with parallel-web (primary), gget, bioservices, venue-templates; excellent integration guidance; mandatory visual elements with scientific-schematics; minor: error handling for multi-database failures could be more explicit

key_strengths: Comprehensive 7-phase systematic review workflow (planning, search, screening, extraction, synthesis, verification, document generation) following PRISMA and Cochrane methodology
Excellent integration strategy with parallel-web as PRIMARY search tool supplemented by specialized database skills (gget, bioservices, datacommons-client)
Strong quality assurance with mandatory citation verification (verify_citations.py), reproducible search documentation, and common pitfalls section
Mandatory visual elements with scientific-schematics integration for PRISMA flow diagrams, thematic synthesis diagrams, and research gap visualizations
Perfect agent discoverability with 7 explicit use cases, clear when-to-use guidance, and comprehensive integration with 9+ other skills

recommendations.title: Add explicit workflow for adapting review to specific venue
recommendations.problem: Venue-specific style guides listed but no workflow showing when/how to apply them during review preparation
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific composability focuses on venue-templates availability rather than integration workflow
recommendations.fix: Add to core_workflow.md or new venue_adaptation.md: workflow showing when to consult venue-templates (after synthesis, before document generation), how to adapt abstract format, structure, and tone to match target venue

recommendations.title: Add error handling for multi-database API failures
recommendations.problem: Multiple databases recommended but no guidance on handling when one API fails during search
recommendations.root_cause: Reliability section focuses on reproducibility rather than runtime failures
recommendations.fix: Add to best practices or troubleshooting: pattern for handling API failures (continue with available databases, document failed sources, adjust synthesis to note coverage limitations)

recommendations.title: Add guidance on handling potentially malicious PDFs during screening
recommendations.problem: Full-text screening involves downloading PDFs but no security guidance on malicious documents
recommendations.root_cause: Security section focuses on credentials rather than file handling
recommendations.fix: Add to security section: guidance on PDF sandboxing during full-text screening, using PDF preview/readers with security features, avoiding automatic script execution
